main_text.p: tur:quin potius reges in gente sua unxit. Ab hoc Petrus Apostolus, prophetarum ducit initium.
90. Iotham, filius Gideonis natu minimus, stultitiam & sæuitiam Sichemitis exprobrat, & de futuro urbis excidio vaticinatur.f

91. Noemi, cum marito Elimelech & duobus filiis, ad alendam se atque familiam, penuriæ tempore, è Iudæa in terram Moabitarum se confert.Marito ibidem defuncto, filiis puellas exteras despondet.Filiis quoque defunctis, ipsa redit in patriam, Bethlehemum, comitante Ru-10thâ nuru.

92. Ruth, Moabitis, orba marito & pauperⅽula, socrū Noëmim[?] loco matris honorat, eique senectutem & orbitatem suâ pietate & obseruantia leniorem efficit. Viro autem nobili & locupleti Booz iuncta connubio, fru-15[?]ctus suæ pietatis magnos & insperatos percipit. Facta enim regis Dauidis auia est, & tertia è mulieribus pere-grinis in genealogia Christi ponitur.
93. Booz[?], Salmonis filius, homo potens & magnâ in re Rutham sibi despondet, & ex eâ suscipit Obedum, a-20[?]vum Dauidis.
94. Helcanas, pater Samuelis, fuit bonus pater, quia fi-liis exemplum pietatis extitit: & commodus maritus, quia vxoris alt:rius[?] morositatem, alterius sterilitatem patienter tulit.25[?]
95. Penina, vxor Helcanæ, mulier superba, Annam quia sterilis esset, exagitat.
96. Anna, mater Samuelis, matrona pia & patiens, multos annos degit sterilis.

97. Ophni, & Pinehas, filii Heli, summâ dignitate prae-30[?]diti, nihil honori sacerdotum egerunt conueniens, profani, indocti, indiligentes, auari, libidinosi, vecordes, im-pii. Ob quæ scelera graviter fuerunt à Deo puniti. Vide paulo ante n. 88.
98. Aminadab, homo integerrimus, arcam Dei, à Phi-35[?]listæis remissam hospitio accipit: quæ ibi mansit usque ad Dauidis tempora.

page.notes: Marginal numerals in the right margin are read from a small, worn scan; "15", "20", "25", "30" and "35" are uncertain. The mark "s" beside line 90 is a printed reference sign, read as f. Line 91 "Noemi" is followed by a comma inside the italic. Text "Noëmim[?]" in 92 is unclear, as is "Booz[?]" in 93 (the z is a long-tailed form). "alt:rius" in 94 shows a colon-like mark where a letter seems missing. "tur:quin" at the top of the page is printed as read. Printing spacing "confert.Marito", "defuncto,filiis", "defunctis,ipsa" is left as printed. Long s is read as plain s throughout.
